verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a workaround for composing workflows. Webhooks give a URL that can be called "from another" scenario to trigger its execution. Data stores can pass data between individual scenarios, and on-demand scenarios exist as a callable concept. Nothing documents a native sub-scenario or module-call feature with defined inputs and outputs inside the visual builder. Missing for 10: a native sub-workflow/call-scenario module, documented input/output contracts and return values for called scenarios, reuse or versioning of shared modules, and independent hands-on corroboration.
